headline: MeCure Industries Expands Assets to N93.35 Billion Amid Rising Debt
summary: MeCure Industries Plc expanded its asset base to N93.35 billion in the nine months ended September 2026, alongside an increasing debt burden.
why: MeCure Industries is a prominent healthcare and pharmaceutical player in Nigeria, and its balance sheet trends reflect the capital expenditure and financing costs in the local market.

impacts.name: MeCure Industries
impacts.why: Asset expansion was accompanied by rising financial liabilities.
